scope: Bound first-copy encryption when enabling combined or single-role autosave
behavior: Initial encryption has a three-minute continuation deadline before any storage write.
Expiry releases setup controls and retains passwords/confirmation for explicit retry. An expired result cannot write the initial copy, mark the session saved or activate the writer.
Storage acknowledgement remains separately bounded; an already-started write may commit even if confirmation is delayed.

unit.scope: Two activation cases reject old encryption during a newer pending retry; combined/role persistence and active-writer deadline regressions also pass.

browser.scope: Four new combined/role desktop/mobile cases hold real PBKDF2 key results beyond virtual expiry. Real AES encryption returns late without an IndexedDB put; explicit retry performs one write and activates autosave. Four existing combined autosave cases also pass.

release.scope: Normal web build/typecheck and release manifest restored after browser tests.

limits: WebCrypto is not cancelled; browser timing uses a virtual clock and delayed derived-key results, not physical suspension.
This increment does not bound role file export or browser-copy unlocking; those remain separate workflows.
No full regression, runtime-image refresh, native wallet ceremony or public deployment.
